reason: The submitted CIF parses and symmetry-expands in Cmmm (No. 65) to the stated 4.680924 x 8.456129 x 3.032729 A cell with 8 fully occupied atoms, Zr2Ti4O2 and Z=2; primitive standardization gives 4 atoms and ZrTi2O. DICVOL indexed all 18 supplied lines (M(18)=189.4, F(18)=138.9), and all 27 detected reflections are covered with 0.0076 deg 2theta RMS and no important extra or missing line. The trace instantiated the atomic models, refined Ti coordinates against the profile, and explicitly tested oxygen arrangements: the selected arrangement had weighted profile RMS 0.424 versus at least 0.578 for other enumerated sites and about 0.66-0.71 for the literature/incorrect oxygen models. An independent integrated-intensity check of the submitted CIF gives 2.4% absolute area residual and 0.9997 correlation after only scale and isotropic intensity falloff, while swapping the two multiplicity-2 Zr/O assignments gives 83% residual and 0.13 correlation. The P6/mmm hypothesis is rejected by resolved orthorhombic peak splitting, and the doubled-c description was correctly reduced as an exact translation duplicate. Periodic shells have no overlaps (minimum 2.098 A); O has four Ti neighbors at 2.098 A and two Zr at 2.340 A, consistent with a metallic suboxide. Thus an explicit ordered realization has convergent positional and atomic-intensity support, and the concrete symmetry, cell-multiplicity, oxygen-site, and direct Zr/O-ordering alternatives are rejected.
